hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) command -v goimports >/dev/null && goimports -w "$f" || gofmt -w "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */openspec/changes/*/tasks.md) case "$f" in */openspec/changes/archive/*) ;; *) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && bash scripts/sync-issues.sh --auto >/dev/null 2>&1 &) ;; esac ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
[ -f go.mod ] || exit 0; golangci-lint run ./... && go test ./...
git ls-files --error-unmatch .env >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo 'Blocked: .env is tracked in git -- see .claude/rules/security.md' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
